usage: tunnel recordings export [-h] [--base BASE] [--json] -o DIR
                                [--session NAME] [--raw]

options:
  -h, --help      show this help message and exit
  --base BASE     where the admin API answers (default http://127.0.0.1:8000)
  --json          print raw JSON, errors included, for piping into jq
  -o, --out DIR   where to write the tree; it is the one `import` reads
  --session NAME  only this session (default: all)
  --raw           keep header values instead of [REDACTED]
